LanguageData.LP_Deity_Bane.label: Bane
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Bane.description: Bane, god of tyranny, worshipped by the Thayan expedition. The possessed carries a fear aura (enemies within 12 cells get shooting accuracy -15%, move speed ×0.85), and every 20 seconds commands the nearest 3 enemies in sight to drop their weapons (mind resistance can resist it); Thayan soldiers within 20 cells don't flee and sigil trolls don't go berserk. When it falls the divine power is drained away, and followers within 20 cells scatter at once.
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Surtr.label: Surtur
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Surtr.description: Surtur, king of fire giants, worshipped by the ember clan. The possessed is completely immune to fire, and 20% of the cells it walks over catch fire; with enemies around, every 25 seconds it sweeps with a flaming sword (radius 3, 20 fire damage and ignites); each hit taken gives +5% melee damage (up to +50%). When it falls it combusts inside (radius 4, 25 fire damage), badly burned but surviving.
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Ilsvi.label: Ilsensine
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Ilsvi.description: Ilsensine, god of the mind flayers, worshipped by the Underdark colony. The possessed is immune to all psychic effects, and every 15 seconds drives one enemy within 15 cells into a frenzy for 10 seconds (mind resistance can resist it; those tadpoles can't parasitize, such as liches, fire giants and necromantic constructs, are immune); dominated thralls within 20 cells deal +15% damage. After falling its brain matter is burned out: permanent brain damage and dementia, it can be captured, and a mind flayer devouring its brain gains +60 brain matter.
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Tyr.label: Tyr
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Tyr.description: Tyr, god of justice, worshipped by the witch-hunting zealots. The 10 cells around the possessed are a court of judgment: enemies can't use any abilities; every 30 seconds it strikes the enemy in sight with the most crimes with retribution (10 + crimes × 5, up to 60); can't be stunned or downed by pain. When it falls it submits to judgment and surrenders outright: no more bleeding, can be captured, recruiting difficulty halved.
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Lathander.label: Lathander
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Lathander.description: Lathander, god of dawn, worshipped by Faerûn's pioneer league (only appears when the league is hostile to you). Friendlies within 10 cells of the possessed lose 5 severity per wound per hour; every 30 seconds it strikes an enemy in sight with a pillar of light (20 holy damage, ×2 against undead); the first time it's knocked down it gets back up at full health. When it falls a second time the dawn recedes and it can be captured normally.
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Vlaakith.label: Vlaakith
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Vlaakith.description: Vlaakith, lich-queen of the githyanki, worshipped by githyanki mercenaries. Every 20 seconds the possessed makes an astral strike (jumping behind the farthest colonist in sight, with the next melee hit guaranteed), and all melee carries 8 psychic damage (×2 against mind flayers); when it dies, 2 githyanki warriors jump out of the Astral Plane for revenge. After falling the corpse turns to ash; it can't be captured and has no soul to drain.
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Talos.label: Talos
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Talos.description: Talos, god of storms, worshipped by vanilla pirates (only once enabled in mod settings). Every 40 seconds the possessed strikes lightning within 3 cells of a colonist; while it's on the map the weather is forced to thunderstorm, and enemies within 10 cells get shooting accuracy -10%. When it falls a bolt strikes itself; it survives but is badly hurt.
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Malar.label: Malar
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Malar.description: Malar, god of the hunt, worshipped by vanilla savage tribes (only once enabled in mod settings). On entering, the possessed makes 2-4 wild animals on the map hunt colonists (if there are no wild animals, 2 wolves come from the map edge), melee damage +25%, and every 60 seconds makes one colony animal within 15 cells go out of control for 30 seconds (not while someone with Animals ≥10 is right next to it). When it falls the wildness fades and the driven beasts calm down.
